_comment: Single owner for this app's deployment topology (Global Rule 12). The Caddy site file, compose.yaml (both gitignored, per release) and the Kubernetes manifests in deploy/k8s/ (committed, drift-checked) are GENERATED from this file by scripts/gen-deploy-artifacts.mjs — never hand-edit the generated copies. The shared-VPS ownership row lives in the private _shared-infrastructure/INFRASTRUCTURE.md registry.
_replicas: Replicas on the shared VPS. Each takes loopbackPort + index, so raising this ALLOCATES ports on a shared host: inspect live state (ss -tlnp) and update the registry first. 1 is the current allocation.

proxy._comment: Caddy upstream pool. healthIntervalSeconds must stay below SELF_HOST_DRAIN_DELAY_MS, or a draining replica keeps receiving traffic. upstreamKeepaliveSeconds must stay below SELF_HOST_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT_MS.

shutdown._comment: Orchestrator kill timeout. Must exceed runtime.drainDelayMs + runtime.shutdownGraceMs.

runtime._comment: Server lifecycle timings for every GENERATED deployment. The generator injects them into the container environment (overriding app.env / the ConfigMap) and asserts the invariants against these exact values, so what is checked is what runs. src/lib/config.ts defaults apply only when the server runs outside a generated deployment.

healthcheck._comment: Liveness check: compose healthcheck, Kubernetes livenessProbe and startupProbe. livenessPath must be the cheap endpoint deploy/server.ts answers without touching dependencies.

kubernetes._comment: Reference topology for running beyond one host. Not deployed anywhere today. The image is a placeholder: a kustomize overlay or CI must pin it by digest per release (imagePullPolicy Always guards the mutable tag until then). ingressNamespace is the only namespace allowed to reach the pods.
kubernetes._startupProbe: periodSeconds x failureThreshold is the startup budget before liveness takes over.
kubernetes._readinessFailureThreshold: 1: a draining pod leaves the endpoints on its first 503.
kubernetes._autoscalingBehavior: Scale up fast, scale down slowly: a spike should never wait, and flapping costs more than an idle replica.
